summary: This document is Section B of the 2026 TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks and establishes coding instructions for premiums and losses. It defines line, form, occupancy, construction, roof, deductible, type-of-loss, cause-of-loss, prior-claims, ZIP, TWIA building-credit, law-and-ordinance, optional-endorsement, and rating-variable-use reporting codes. The extraction focuses on prose/context and CodeList-level structure, with detailed CodeValue nodes for the Cause of Loss list because it is central to loss reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Statistical Plan
proposed_nodes.description: Statistical plan identifier for Residential Risk – Dwellings – Homeowners (HO), code 4.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — State Code
proposed_nodes.description: State identifier for Texas, code 42.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Kind Codes – Losses
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates loss record kind codes 1–9 for records with no current payment/outstanding loss, reopened paid losses, non-reopened paid losses, and outstanding loss amounts based on prior closed-status history.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Line of Business
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates residential line-of-business codes for homeowners, dwelling fire/property/time element, liability, wind-only, theft, extended coverage, private flood, supplemental natural disaster protection, and TWIA-only surcharges.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Policy Forms
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners, tenants, condominium, dwelling, ISO, AAIS, and independent approved policy form codes by line of business.
proposed_nodes.notes: Homeowners/dwellings forms include numeric codes 1–5 and 9; other approved forms include alpha and numeric codes A–Z and 6–8.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Number of Families
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates number-of-families/personal-property combinations for homeowners, dwellings, and tenants forms, including codes 1, 2, 8, and 9.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Coverage – Occupancy
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners and dwelling fire/extended coverage occupancy codes, including owner-occupied, non-owner-occupied, tenant forms, condominium contents, vacant occupancy, liability-only, and other endorsement-related classifications.
proposed_nodes.notes: Use of Code 7 for vacant occupancy requires TICO approval before reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Construction
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates construction codes for frame, brick/stone veneer, brick/stone/masonry, fire resistive and semi-fire resistive, mobile/manufactured home, stucco/asbestos, and not applicable, with classification definitions and predominant-construction rules for mixed construction.
proposed_nodes.notes: Predominant construction is based on over 50% of exterior wall area for mixed construction; with more than two constructions, use the majority of total exterior wall area, excluding gables.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Roof Construction
proposed_nodes.description: For non-tenants and non-condominium risks, reports roof covering, roof credit, and roof year. Roof covering codes A–P identify predominant roof covering type. Roof credit codes 0–4 identify UL2218 or TDI-approved impact-resistance credits. Roof year is reported in YYYY format or 0000 if unused in underwriting or rating.
proposed_nodes.notes: Roof credit should be reported only for roof coverings meeting UL2218 or other TDI-approved standards; ineligible policies are reported as 0.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates whether the cosmetic damage to roof coverings exclusion endorsement is attached: code 0 not attached; code 1 attached.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)
proposed_nodes.description: Reports ISO PPC if used in rating, using codes 1–9, A, and B, where A reports PPC 10 and B reports PPC 8B.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates two-character ISO PPC split-classification codes, including 01–10 and split combinations such as 12, 13, 19, 20, 22, 23, through 82 and 83.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates deductible codes for homeowners and dwellings across wind/hail, other-than-wind/hail, tenants/condominium, tropical cyclone, dwelling extended coverage, personal property, and dwelling coverages. Includes instructions for selecting the deductible code based on major buildings, principal property, wind and hail coverage, and largest amount of insurance or premium.
proposed_nodes.notes: Code 1 has special meaning in Seacoast Territories 1, 8, 9, 10, and 11; Code 7 applies in specified catastrophe-area territories subject to Wind Exclusion Endorsement.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners type-of-loss codes for Section I dwellings, unscheduled personal property, Section II personal liability and medical payments, company enhancement endorsement losses, and other additional premium-paying endorsement losses.
proposed_nodes.notes: Watercraft losses covered under the basic policy are reported as code 1 when horsepower/length thresholds are met.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Cause of Loss
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners and dwellings cause-of-loss codes and requires reporting the original and proximate cause of loss, not ensuing causes.
proposed_nodes.notes: The rule gives windstorm/rain and freeze/burst-pipe examples and distinguishes internal-source fire from external-source fire.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates prior-claims-history codes for zero through five-or-more chargeable claims in the last five years, and code 6 when the company does not use prior claims history in rating or tiering.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.description: TWIA-only building-code-credit codes for seaward, Inland I, and Inland II new structures, higher-standard construction, retrofitted structures, and not applicable.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes codes 01 through 09.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates law and ordinance coverage codes for no additional coverage, 10%, 15%, 25%, and other approved purchased limits.
proposed_nodes.notes: No additional coverage code excludes the amount otherwise provided in the policy.

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Optional Credit – Personal Property ID (HO)
proposed_nodes.description: HO optional credit codes indicating whether the optional credit for personal property ID does not apply (0) or applies (1).

proposed_nodes.name: CodeList — Rating Variable Use
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit codes indicating how specified rating variables are used in rating or tiering: used with no discount/surcharge, discount/factor under 1.000, surcharge/factor over 1.000, tier placement without specific factor, or not used.
proposed_nodes.notes: Variables include alarms, age of home, sprinkler system, loss/claims experience, companion policy, credit-based insurance score, senior citizen, smart/connected home, new/recently purchased home, and additional risk surcharges for attractive nuisances, animals/breeds, or uncommon features.

proposed_nodes.name: EndorsementRule — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.form_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Excludes cosmetic damage to roof coverings when attached; coding rule reports attachment status.

proposed_nodes.name: EndorsementRule — Wind Exclusion Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced in footnotes for deductible code 7; no form number is given in this excerpt.
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Excludes wind coverage for specified catastrophe-area territories when deductible code 7 applies.
